parameters.name: BackupPlanId
parameters.description: The ID of the backup plan. Call the [DescribeBackupPlanList](~~2869825~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dbs start-backup-plan --backup-plan-id dbsqdss5tmh0000 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzxxxxxxx --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
